title: S04 — Candidate solutions
body:
# S04 — Candidate solutions

## Candidates

1. Hand-written per-transport routes.
2. One ActionSpec registry with a derive macro (chosen).
3. Code generation at build time from a separate DSL.

## Criteria

One source of truth; no drift between transports; the lock pins the served spec; the invocation
path audits.

## Options rejected

Candidate 1 drifts and forks the audit path. Candidate 3 adds a second language surface without
removing the registry. Candidate 2 is the shipped path.
